purpose: Fixed top navigation (dark variant, the homepage only): Rive wordmark, Product / Customers / Resources mega-menus, Pricing, Login and two buttons. Fixed content from src/navData.js; not composable per page.

responsive.change: the 106px desktop bar is replaced by the 64px phone bar (MobileNav) with a hamburger

notes: Menu copy, icons and hrefs are fixed data in src/navData.js (PRODUCT_ITEMS, PLATFORM_ITEMS, CUSTOMER_GROUPS, RESOURCE_*). A PageSpec cannot override them.
The wordmark is a Rive state machine (@rive-app/canvas) on the live site; the static SVG shows until it loads.
